scope: All ten distinct pilot records, reviewed after seeing A/B model labels and prior notes; NOT a blind or independent Reviewer C arbitration.

exact_overlap_test.match_rule: literal target_text + full ordered visible_history + target_semantics equal

classification_legend.UNSUPPORTED_SEVERE_SUSPECTED: The specific serious player-agency label appears insufficiently grounded in visible source; still requires independent adjudication.
classification_legend.CONTEXTUAL_AMBIGUITY_HOLD: Potential player-agency issue exists but user-initiated action, timing, consent, physical NPC action, or roleplay convention needs further source review.
classification_legend.SAFETY_POLICY_HOLD: The sample contains sexual/coercion or age-context concerns; separate policy evaluation needed, do not infer absence of safety issue.

case_reviews.secondary: Player-agency severity not established by NPC-initiated action alone
Time jump and unprompted player actions need agency-boundary adjudication
User supplied player-initiated massage; NPC response and reaction should not be conflated with player substitution
User explicitly referenced returning to town; NPC accepting this direction is not itself an overriding player choice
Player indicated disengagement; NPC stopping player physically needs consent and roleplay-policy boundary review
NPC physical contact and pressure must be assessed separately from authoring a new player decision; safety context unresolved
Sexual coercion/context requires a distinct safety assessment; no basis to conflate NPC response with player agency automatically
NPC's threatening or controlling speech is not necessarily a completed player action
Model attributes additional player intent/actions; severity threshold needs contextual review
Ordinary interaction; high player-agency score and positive literary note conflict with triple severe flags, no clear visible support

methods: Posthoc AI case-by-case source-context review, preserving original five A v2 and five B v3 decisions. No private content, IDs, quotes, or names emitted. Not independent blind. These are screening priority markers, not formal ACCEPT/REJECT judgments.
limits: No Owner crosswalk independently executed or full SHA receipt replay yet; although 5x5 first-five exact content overlap was zero, the remaining 995 rows in each slot have not been matched to their opposite-slot results. The ten findings cannot be extrapolated to the 1000 source pool or treated as policy decisions.
next: Run owner-only pairwise audit for full frozen source and checkpoints; then independent, preferably blind severity adjudication of case labels. Do not automatically promote model REJECT into dataset exclusion or train.
